title: Okha Hogaya Akbar Laye Sughra Nu Samjauna
body:
Tu Manta Man Day Ray Jaana (x2)
Akbar Nay Mur Nayi Aona.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kiway Sughra Nu Kaway Behji Na Mehdi Karbal Wich (x2)
Kiway Sughra Nu Kaway,
Barchi Nal Mehndiya Laaway Ga (x2)
Tera Akbar Jagh Tu Sohna.
<<DIVIDER>>
Injh Band Howan Gay Ay Jandray Fair Khulnay Nayi (x2)
Injh Band Howan Gay Ay,
Ay Ghaar Ay Wehray Howan Gay (x2)
Paar Waasi Koyi Nayi Hona.
<<DIVIDER>>
Naal Babay Di Bitha Veera Nu Wekh Lay Rajh Kay (x2)
Naal Babay Di Bitha
Ik Waari Jay Ay Guzar Gaya (x2)
Ay Wehla Fair Nayi Aona.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaak Tay Qadma Di Daswi Nu Tu Wi Soh Jaawi (x2)
Khaak Tay Qadma Di
Karbal Wich Shaam-e-gharbian Nu (x2)
Assah Sareya Khaak Tay Sona.
<<DIVIDER>>
Turday Mehmal Akbar Mayatan Day Waang Laghday Nai (x2)
Turday Mehmal Akbar,
Takdi Rayi Khulliyan Akhiya Naal (x2)
Ay Saara Khaab Darouna.
